basis: Supplied requirements establish exact clamping expectations below, within, and above inclusive bounds; tests use literal expected values.
Negative values, zero, both boundaries, interior values, and equal bounds are covered.
Reversed bounds must throw RangeError; tests check values below, at, between, and above those bounds.
Tests use deterministic named Node test/assert cases and a relative import matching the supplied source export. Acceptance does not establish execution or mutation quality.
